sql_profile: MySQL 8.0/8.4 InnoDB, strict SQL mode, session UTC, RepeatableRead current reads; exact DDL and execution plans require A/C review plus real MySQL before catalog admission

column_conventions.scope_key: BINARY(32) NOT NULL, producer scope digest; all loads also compare exact Scope canonical bytes to defeat hash-key mismatch
column_conventions.scope_bytes: VARBINARY(1024) NOT NULL, canonical Scope; retained on domain and all history/receipts
column_conventions.hash: BINARY(32) NOT NULL; lowercase hex only in JSON projection
column_conventions.id: VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL; ID regex excludes spaces so SQL pad semantics cannot alias accepted IDs
column_conventions.evidence_id: VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL; exactly EvidenceID pattern and same SQL type/collation as referenced existing evidence public_id must be verified when writing DDL
column_conventions.counter: BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL CHECK(value>0); refuse overflow rather than wrap
column_conventions.zero_counter: BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL; zero means no result/no previous target, never wildcard
column_conventions.time: DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, UTC microseconds; nullable only where explicitly listed
column_conventions.record_bytes: MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL, typed-frame canonical record, OCTET_LENGTH <= table record_max_bytes. Mandatory decode/schema/semantic check plus exact correspondence to indexed columns on every load. Not a second permissive authority source. No raw credential or plaintext evidence.
column_conventions.record_sha256: BINARY(32) NOT NULL, SHA256(record_bytes), integrity check only, not authentication
column_conventions.record_storage: Every schema field is retained in record_bytes. Listed columns are typed/indexed projections and MUST agree with the full record; additional columns are derived keys. Updates regenerate complete canonical bytes and digest in the same CAS. Immutable tables reject byte changes.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_domains
checks: record length bound and exact scope/column correspondence
tables.lifecycle: Provision by independent trusted deployment admission, lock installation/config prefix first; config absence enforced even if orphan config exists. Preserve scope key and monotonically advance epoch forever. Bootstrap closes unconfigured epoch atomically. No FK that creates installation/config.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_grants
tables.lifecycle: Grant ID never reused. domain_epoch is a snapshot, intentionally not a FK to mutable current epoch. Every live operation locks/compares current domain epoch; renewal only before lease expiry with exact CAS.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_runs
checks: (observed_at IS NULL AND observation_expires_at IS NULL AND state IN (acquired,superseded)) OR (observed_at IS NOT NULL AND observation_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND observed_at<observation_expires_at)
tables.lifecycle: One run/evidence per grant. Reserve evidence ID before pending without FK to not-yet-created evidence. Generation comes from target CAS. Only acquired->pending fixes observation; later changes preserve original dates/deadline.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_targets
tables.lifecycle: No physical current_run FK: avoids insert cycle/backward FK lock. Transaction validates exact run/target relation after run keys locked at L4. Keep generation fence even after historical GC. Never reset result_version when a new run starts.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_evidence_bindings
tables.lifecycle: New row key locked L4, inserted atomically with pending/chunks at L8 after referenced run already locked. No FK to mutable config/epoch or evidence: GC may clear evidence payload but cannot remove historical binding until reviewed retention/references permit. SQL transaction checks exact evidence ownership. immutable_version in original binding stays null; observed immutable version belongs to evidence and result receipt.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_result_receipts
checks: canonical stored request rehash matches request_hash and receipt_key_hash
tables.lifecycle: Immutable, independent historical auth/read. No FK to mutable authorization/config; logical run/evidence binding checked under L4/L8. No upsert that changes bytes. Keep until idempotency/authorization/observation horizons plus configured receipt retention expire and all holds clear.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_command_receipts
checks: canonical command rehash matches request_hash and receipt_key_hash
tables.lifecycle: Acquire/renew/revoke/takeover have separate domain-separated keys bound to authenticated actor; immutable same-request replay never performs a second lease mutation or capacity charge. Authenticated deployment-domain provisioning has its own reviewed deployment receipt, never an implicit Acquire fallback.

tables.name: system_backup_producer_evidence_refs
checks: exact validated ReferenceRecord and scope/evidence mapping
tables.lifecycle: Missing reference range locked at L5; new reference only inserted after L8 evidence readiness and no GC claim check. No backward evidence FK lock during L5. Holds can extend only via independent management authority and CAS/old protected_until comparison.

result_projection.unconfigured: Commit candidate results to producer target/result receipt/references only. Never write live provider/dependency success projections or create installation/config. Bootstrap reads exact reviewed candidate receipt/evidence, rechecks original observation, and closes domain; no implicit permission conversion.
result_projection.configured: Require exact active installation/current config matching disabled/enabled admission. Provider roles map to all admitted capability slots; A dependency roles map only admitted dependency kinds. Lock legacy unique keys/ranges at L5, then atomically update complete result set with target/result CAS and evidence refs. disabled checks cannot change enabled state.
result_projection.legacy_key_aliases: Legacy provider/dependency projection unique keys omit probe_scope/profile. Different target scopes may alias one legacy slot. Configured admission must designate one canonical target key per legacy projection slot; lock and recheck that config-owned mapping at L1/L5. Other scopes remain candidate receipts only and cannot overwrite live projections. No last-writer-wins across target keys.
result_projection.evaluator: Authenticated profile selects full sorted set; provider all codes from a-capability-role-mapping.json. KMS -> kek; signing -> signing; Secret requires A explicit admitted dependency-kind set (no default auto projection). A evaluator attestation is independently checked, evidence-ready alone never implies healthy.

capacity.profile: producer-reservation.c1, conservative admission reservation, not an estimate of exact InnoDB physical bytes
capacity.new_row_cost: 65536 + ceil(record_max_bytes/4096)*4096 per retained row, independent of shorter actual payload; total additionally includes 65536 per transaction and existing evidence/chunk/audit/projection admission costs exactly once
capacity.mutation_cost: Every retained command receipt (including renewal/revoke) is charged. In-place updates to already fully reserved record bounds add no new row cost; new revisions stored separately are charged as new rows. Fresh evidence/refs and expanded result sets charged before inserts.
capacity.reserve: Use same existing metadata reservation id=1 under L6; arithmetic checked for uint64/int64 overflow before SQL; within configured metadata budget and physical headroom. Pinned collector identity and original sample must still be <=5s old after waits and at final guard.
capacity.replay: Read-only exact receipt replay has zero charge and no timestamp refresh. New mutation after replay never inherits the prior charge or authority.
capacity.release: No automatic reset from a newer report. Do not decrement for producer GC until a separately reviewed reconciliation can prove deletion and physical accounting. Conservative reservations may exhaust budget; block safely and report capacity_unavailable.
capacity.failure: Rollback reservation with all local state on admission/CAS/audit/guard failure. Revocation safety must not depend on ability to allocate a new command receipt: independent domain epoch close/revocation record is preallocated by deployment admission; its emergency path needs A deployment-review evidence before runtime.

references_and_gc.scope: All existing task/config/catalog/promotion/log/evidence-reference owner policies remain required. New table does not replace them.
references_and_gc.range: At L5 lock producer refs by (scope_key,evidence_id) prefix including empty range, target/projection slots and legacy refs/holds in stable order, then evidence L8. New refs require same locks and reject GC claim/deleting/deleted.
references_and_gc.pending_unknown: Never delete history, original ciphertext or pending/write_unknown solely on retention expiry. Independent resolution and proof that no writes/references remain required; inability to prove holds the bytes and capacity.
references_and_gc.result_refs: Current configured result and live bootstrap candidate reference keep evidence through original observation/required retention. Immutable receipt refs keep it through receipt retention. Replacing result retires only its own reference, not receipt/hold references.
references_and_gc.history: Keep domain and target generation tombstones permanently. Purging historical rows requires expired write/observation/receipt horizons, resolved storage state, no claim/ref/hold and no child FK; preserve compact replay tombstones before deleting receipts. Tombstone format and purge implementation require separate review; until then retain all receipts/history.
references_and_gc.sidecar: All eight tables are excluded control objects from resources backup/restore; only redacted aggregate integrity/retention summaries may enter sidecar. No raw admission identity, requests, credential material or original evidence body exported.

required_mysql_checks: complete proposed DDL/legacy FK collation compatibility
capacity and audit waits past expiry
final write wait then UTC recheck
commit response loss and locking readback
